cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18.0 FATAL_ERROR)
project(CsSvgRepro)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

find_package(CopperSpice REQUIRED)

# generated by rcc (qrc_resources.cpp)
COPPERSPICE_RESOURCES(
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources.qrc
)

add_executable(cs-svg-repro
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/svgrepro_render.cpp
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/svgrepro_window.cpp
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/svgtextobject.cpp
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources.qrc
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qrc_resources.cpp
)

target_include_directories(cs-svg-repro PRIVATE
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

target_link_libraries(cs-svg-repro
   CopperSpice::CsCore
   CopperSpice::CsGui
   CopperSpice::CsSvg
)

install(TARGETS cs-svg-repro DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
